summary: A man speaking Hindi is corrected in real-time by an AI avatar who translates his sentences into English. The avatar introduces the Speakeasy app, explaining how users can practice speaking in their native language to learn English. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and start a trial for just ₹1.
